{{Top|leg}}
'''Maintenance Logs''' were reports kept during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jan Stakross]] kept such a log, using those logs to warn individuals not to take the [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16]] to [[Agarrees Shipyard Township]].<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] databank}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Maintenance Logs were mentioned in several databank entries of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUII" />
